about.text: A yak's-milk cheese, influenced by Tibetan cuisine. Depending on how it is prepared, Chhurpi can be either hard and chewy, or soft.

sources.text: Boiled buttermilk curd; soft fresh form and hard smoked-dried form; no drying times in source
Boiled buttermilk curd; soft fresh form and hard smoked-dried form; no drying times in source

facts.v: Chugo is the third most-produced dairy product in Bhutan, after datshi and butter (2018 figures)
The dehydrated hard form, chewed at altitude, made in Arunachal Pradesh and Sikkim from cow or yak milk
